$comment: Quality presets (spec: Performance budget). low = the stream laptop (default). ?preset=high on a stronger PC. ?preset=lite = no shadows, fewer people: use it only if low drops below 30 FPS. look.style: "lowpoly" = faceted shapes and flat colours (D41), "film" = the soft animated-film look (D25); ?style=film or ?style=lowpoly overrides it. flatColors: true = plain colours, false = painted detail kept on the facets (PK wants textured detail). mobile = the Android phone build of the Kingdom tab (D72): smaller render, no antialias, no shadows. ultra = a strong gaming PC (D79). kingdom = the Kingdom's Anno-style graphics (D79): ao = soft contact shadows (aoScale = its render size), bloom = glow, tiltShift = close-up blur, grade = warm golden-hour colour, water = 'shader' (waves, depth colour, foam) or 'flat', treeKinds = how many tree kinds (1-5), wind = trees sway, life = birds, smoke, garden plots, palms on the paddy dikes, props = PK's real 3D models for trees, palms, rocks and banana plants (config/kingdom/props.json; off on lite and the phone), diorama = PK 1.7.0's Angkor Cel-Diorama look (config/kingdom/diorama.json: NPR toon units with ink outlines, stylised PBR land, HD-2D long lens, tilt-shift, warm/cool grade, laterite/emerald terrain, Prek canal water, ground detail; no screen-space AO). PK 1.8.0: elephantGrass = tall grass rolling in the wind (config/kingdom/diorama.json elephantGrass), grassShadows = it casts shadows (an extra pass), torchLights = how many real lights the nearest night torches give (0 = glow only; config/kingdom/anachak.json night.torches), seeThrough = cover turns see-through round people when zoomed in. atmosphere = ground mist and light shafts (diorama.json atmosphere). sward = the 30 cm meadow grass over every green tile (diorama.json sward, PK's Meshy model). PK 1.9.0 (D144 k1, D146 ខ២, D149): pc1660 = the GTX 1660 Super preset (high plus 4096 shadows and PK's Meshy buildings, kingdom.meshyModels); it becomes the stream preset once PK has measured it on his PC (🖥 on the year bar: live FPS and a preset switch). meshyModels: PK's Meshy buildings (props.json buildings marked pc) — off on low, lite and the phone, where the budget keeps the built-in shapes. PK 1.9.0 (D152, D153): look.style "real" + kingdom.real on pc1660, high and ultra = the semi-realistic look (smooth shading, the models' own PBR materials, no cartoon rim, no toon units or ink outlines, wide lens, ambient occlusion, 4x antialiasing, no tilt-shift); ?style=real tries it on any preset. PK 2026-10-20 (D163): the phone has the PC's 3D models with the same mapping (mobile kingdom.models = PK's scattered plants and rocks, the near people and animals, boats, fish, buildings and the finished Preah Ko, without the PC's semi-realistic look, its mirror water, antialiasing or post passes; props and meshyModels on); modelTextureMax = their textures shrunk to 1024 px in the phone build (apps/game/tools/phoneModels.ts). PK 2026-10-20 (D165, dragging the map not smooth on the phone): modelMaxTris = still models over this many triangles are simplified in the phone build (people and animals keep their shape); kingdom.scatterRadius / scatterShare = the phone draws PK's scattered plants and rocks within this many metres of the view (PC: props.json scatter.radius) and this share of each kind's count (at least one). PK 2026-10-20 (D166): modelKeepWhole = still models the phone keeps whole (they smear when cut); kingdom.scatterSwap = kinds the phone draws with a lighter model ({file, scale}: the fan palm as the 3 000-triangle palm at its height); kingdom.shade = the soft painted shade under PK's trees where there are no real shadows (strength 0-1, size × the crown's half-width, none under plants lower than minHeight m); kingdom.forestTris = the forest's detailed-tree budgets on the phone (near / mid, RTS and 3D hero; the PC's are props.json treePlacement nearTris 20 000 / 160 000 and midTris 30 000 / 60 000).
